task_prompt: Use the pipette to transfer liquid from the clear cup to the pink solution container.
task_summary: The right hand repeatedly moves the pipette between the clear cup and the pink solution while the left hand rests.

objects.name: clear plastic pipette
properties: A slender tube with a squeezable bulb and narrow dispensing tip.
Bulb compression and release control liquid aspiration and dispensing.
Liquid transfer requires more than positioning the tip over a cup.
objects.evidence: The right hand holds the pipette and alternates between the cups at 0-13 s.

deformation.how_the_task_deforms_it: The fingers squeeze and release the bulb during transfer.

objects.name: clear source cup
properties: Open container supports liquid and permits pipette insertion.
Stays on the tabletop beside the pink cup.
The pipette tip is lowered into its interior.
objects.evidence: Small clear cup is to the right of the pink cup at 0-13 s.

objects.name: pink solution container
properties: Its rim must not be treated as a closed solid top.
Rests on the white paper below the hands.
objects.evidence: The pink solution container remains on the white sheet at 0-13 s.

objects.name: clear liquid
properties: Liquid is aspirated from the source cup and dispensed into the pink solution.
Successful transfer requires an actual amount to leave the source and enter the destination.
The amount transferred is not resolved from the overview images.
objects.evidence: Pipette is inserted and moved between the source and destination at 0-13 s.

subgoals.goal: The pipette is held in the right hand.

subgoals.action: Draw liquid from the clear cup.
